prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1361; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane on a multi-lane roadway in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 moved over from the right lane and contacted the left side of Driver 1's vehicle during a lane change. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee after striking the interior trim during the impact and said a Passenger was also seated in the vehicle at the time. I arrived on scene and observed that Driver 1 was present and was consistent in describing the sequence of events. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the general location of contact and the damage to both vehicles. No independent witnesses came forward. The visible damage is largely consistent with the sideswipe described by both drivers. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known or reported to me. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. A report of the injury was noted, and the reported knee complaint is a plausible result of a collision of this type.
